messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of **long‑weekend holidays** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a continuous three‑day break (or more if you take adjacent days off).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Weekend Days Covered |
|-------------|---------|----------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sun) | New Year’s Day | Dec 31 – Jan 2 (Sat‑Mon) – *Observed* on Jan 2 |
| **Feb 20** (Mon) | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB) | Feb 18 – 20 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Apr 7** (Fri) | Good Friday (all provinces) | Apr 7 – 9 (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** (Mon) | Victoria Day (all provinces) | May 20 – 22 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Jul 1** (Sat) | Canada Day | Jul 1 – 3 (Sat‑Mon) – *Observed* on Jul 3 |
| **Sep 4** (Mon) | Labour Day (all provinces) | Sep 2 – 4 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** (Mon) | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Oct 7 – 9 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Dec 23** (Sat) | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Dec 23 – 25 (Sat‑Mon) |

### Notes & Provincial Variations

| Province/Region | Additional Long‑Weekend Holidays (2023) |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------|
| **Ontario** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – *Observed* on Mar 20 (Mon) |
| **Quebec** | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (Jun 24) – *Observed* on Jun 26 (Mon) |
| **Alberta** | Heritage Day (Aug 21) – *Observed* on Aug 21 (Mon) |
| **British Columbia** | BC Day (Aug 21) – *Observed* on Aug 21 (Mon) |
| **Manitoba** | Manitoba Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **New Brunswick** | New Brunswick Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Nova Scotia** | Nova Scotia Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | PEI Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Saskatchewan** | Saskatchewan Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Northwest Territories** | NWT Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Yukon** | Yukon Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |
| **Nunavut** | Nunavut Day (Aug 15) – *Observed* on Aug 15 (Mon) |

> **Tip for App Integration:**  
> Store each holiday as an object with fields such as `name`, `date`, `observed_date` (if applicable), and `province`.  
> When generating long‑weekend lists, filter holidays where the `date` falls on a Friday or Monday, or where the `observed_date` does.  
> Consider adding a flag for “provincial” holidays so users can toggle visibility based on their location.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need additional provincial holidays!
